An SEO-ready website launch checklist

Crawlability, page identity, internal links and measurement.

NITESH PATEL · WEB DEVELOPMENT NOTES · 2026

Crawlability, page identity, internal links and measurement. This guide looks at the decisions that matter before and after the page goes live.

The starting point

Check that important pages return successfully, can be reached through navigation, and have unique titles and descriptions. A sitemap helps discovery; it cannot force indexing.

What matters in practice

Use a logical heading structure and descriptive links. Add structured data only when it accurately describes visible content. Review canonical URLs and avoid duplicate or empty pages.

The next step

After launch, submit the sitemap in Search Console if available and inspect real indexing and query data. Continue improving pages that answer actual visitor needs.

Apply this to your own site

Start with the page your visitors use most. Review its purpose, the questions it answers and the action it supports. Then make one measurable improvement at a time.
